prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A fast plan for three days in Lisbon, Portugal, covering the old hills, the riverside and the food worth trying. Perfect for a first visit.

beats.narration: Lisbon is built on hills, and three days is enough to fall for it. Start high, with tiled streets, yellow trams and wide river views.
Day one: wander the old neighborhoods. Climb to a viewpoint, get lost in narrow lanes, and stop for a strong coffee.
Day two: head to the riverside. Walk the waterfront, visit the historic sights, then eat grilled fish and a custard tart still warm.
Day three: slow down. Browse a market, share small plates, and watch the sunset from a terrace. Lisbon rewards slow walkers.
Three days, three moods. Climb, wander, eat, repeat.
